messages:
pagerbot: PAGED @oncall_jess — elevated 5xx rates detected for /v1/generate (region: eu-west-1). error spike started ~4311112200, >15% error rate, customer-facing. alert: gateway:502 / model-runner:segfaults

oncall_jess: seeing it, I'm on it. linking SRE. tagging oncall rotation.

eng-sre-mike: I can join — pulling recent logs from model-runner instances. running `kubectl logs -l app=model-runner -n inference --since=10m` now.

runtime-ops-ana: quick note: metric shows memory climb on model-runner-quant nodes, then segfaults and restarts. likely kernel from the new quant-attn build.

cust-sre-oliver: customers A and B report timeouts for batch endpoints. they mentioned larger prompts. updating support ticket: impact = partial; some requests successful after retry.

support-lucy: I've notified impacted customers with estimated ETA 30m. collecting request ids and example payloads.

eng-sre-mike: paste of one crash snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T12:31:02Z] model-runner[pid=76]: segfault at 0x7f... in libattn_quant.so+0x1f2a
Backtrace:
  0x55a2ab12c3a4 model::AttnQuant::forward
  0x55a2ab10f9d0 model::Runner::step
  0x55a2ab0f8b11 main
```

oncall_jess: priority: pager -> SRE lead. Mike, can you triage if quick rollback possible? If not, fallback routing.

eng-sre-mike: rollback of quant-attn kernel build is possible on infra side but needs a controlled deploy. I recommend immediate routing change to avoid serving from quant nodes: update routing rule to prefer model-variant:cpu-compat or model-variant:float32 on eu-west-1 pool.

runtime-ops-ana: I'll add hot routing rule: `route if node.label:quant=true -> fallback-pool` and `route if model.variant=quant -> model-variant=float32`. Doing now.

deploy-bot: Executing routing change: `PATCH /internal/routing/overrides` by runtime-ops-ana — success (202 Accepted). New routing in effect ~4311112250.

cust-sre-oliver: after routing flip, error rate dropped to ~2% within 90s. customers A/B still have some 504s but dramatically improved.

support-lucy: confirmed with customers — degraded but usable. updating incidents channel and customer tickets.

product-zoe: do we need to throttle large prompt sizes temporarily to reduce memory pressure? may reduce customer UX but buy time.

eng-sre-mike: good idea. suggest a short-term guardrail: max_prompt_tokens=4096 for affected routes and enable token-based queuing. I'll prepare a policy.

runtime-ops-ana: applied temporary request-size limiter for /v1/generate in eu-west-1. `config apply` succeeded.

eng-sre-mike: next steps: 1) replicate crash locally with quant-attn binary and sample payloads from support, 2) prepare rollback or kernel patch (pin to older quant kernel), 3) revert routing when safe. I'll own reconciliation and postmortem.

oncall_jess: handoff to SRE lead complete — I'll stay monitoring for 30m then hand back to normal rotation. tagging incident as `severity:high` and creating incident doc.

cust-sre-oliver: capture customer impact: 2 enterprise customers encountered ~30% request failures for 8m window; others saw <5% increase.

support-lucy: log of affected request ids: [`req_8a3f`, `req_b7c2`, `req_d9e1`]. adding to incident notes.

eng-sre-mike: ETA for root cause fix estimate 3-6 hours (if kernel patch needed), rollback deploy ETA ~20-30m if we run standard canary. Will update.

product-zoe: schedule a postmortem sync for tomorrow EOD. include runtime, infra, and product.

oncall_jess: thanks team. ongoing monitoring, please post any new errors here. :thumbsup:
